title: Delivery Claims and Marlowe Rewards Points Reversals: Training Notes
content:
**What is the service-recovery share?**
When a refunded return reverses Marlowe Rewards points, the member's Delivery Claims history sets a service-recovery share. The reversed spend enters the points reversed multiplied by this share. The share is not rounded on its own.

**What share applies when the refunded order has its own delivery claim?**
When the refunded order itself carries a delivery claim in status approved or resolved, the share is 80 percent.

**And when it does not?**
If compensation was booked on any of the member's delivery claims within the 12 months ending on the handling date, the share is 90 percent. Compensation is booked when the claim's history shows compensation issued.

**And otherwise?**
The share is 100 percent.

**How do the three cases rank?**

| Refunded order carries a claim in status approved or resolved | Compensation booked on any of the member's claims in the 12 months ending on the handling date | Service-recovery share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | 80 percent |
| No | Yes | 90 percent |
| No | No | 100 percent |

A claim on the refunded order that stands in any other status, such as opened, under review, denied or withdrawn, does not give the 80 percent share. The member's compensation history then decides between 90 and 100 percent.

**Illustration (hypothetical reversed spend of 80.00 USD).**
At 80 percent it counts as 64.00, at 90 percent as 72.00, and at 100 percent as 80.00.
